events.title: NEW SHOP UPGRADES & SPECIAL ORDERS!
events.summary: Hello, shopkeepers! A new update is now available for the Grombo Card Shop Idle demo, bringing two major new features: a completely new Shop Upgrade System and the Customer Service Desk. IMPROVE YOUR SHOP YOUR WAY The new upgrade system lets you decide how your business evolves. Choose which parts of the shop you want to improve first and invest in the upgrades that best suit the way you play. There is no single correct way to run a card shop. events.title: THE DEMO JUST GOT A LOT SHINIER ✨
events.summary: Hello, shopkeepers! A new update is now available for the Grombo Card Shop Idle demo. This update focuses on making the whole game look better, feel clearer, and be more comfortable to play. We’ve improved the visuals throughout the game, polished lots of UI and UX details, fixed plenty of bugs, and added a brand-new feature: the Store Calendar. events.title: Grombo Demo V3 Is Out Now!
events.summary: Hello, aspiring cardboard tycoons! Demo V3 of Grombo Card Shop Idle is now available! This update does not expand the demo with twenty new systems and a variable-rate mortgage. Instead, we focused on making everything already there feel much clearer, smoother, prettier and more polished. events.title: The New Grombo Card Shop Idle Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: Hello, aspiring cardboard tycoons! A brand-new version of the Grombo Card Shop Idle demo is now available on Steam. We have rebuilt and expanded the demo to offer a much better look at what the game is becoming. There are new cards and Grombos, more ways to manage your business, a completely revamped presentation and many more opportunities to make terrible financial decisions. What’s new in the demo?
